text: 【音乐】Hello, boys and girls.It's really nice to see you again.I'm Miss Seven.Are you ready for the lesson today?Let's begin.In this lesson, you will review what you have learned in Unit 5.Then you are going to listen to a passage,talk about other people's strong points,and describe what you can learn from them.Meanwhile, you are supposed to think about how to learn from others to improve yourself.What can we learn from others?Who can we learn from?Are they great people?Of course.Are they ordinary people?We learn from models.And what can we learn from them?All their strong points.Then why do we learn from others?Please think about it.And you are going to report your answers later.In this unit, we read a fable about Fred and Doris.Can we learn something from them?When the luck fairy wanted to give them three wishes,did they accept them?What did they reply?Do you still remember?Although we are old,we work in the fields every day.They were hardworking.What else did they say?Although we are poor,we live happily.Although our hut is old and small,it's very comfortable.Although our clothes are old,they are still comfortable.Wow, the old couple didn't own muchand lived a poor life.But they were still pleased with their life.They were not greedy.Surely.Should we learn from them?Then what else can we learn from them?Look at these wordsand use although to make up sentences.Although they feel tired,they often keep doing a lot of work in the fields.Although they are not rich, they always share vegetables with neighbors.還有很多模特兒在Mr.Who的課堂裡。你仍然記得Peter和Alice嗎?請用although來介紹他們。Alice和Peter的課堂裡。Although Peter is busy, he always helps his classmates.Alice雖然不強壯,但她總是幫助她的老師。你覺得他們有什麼?是的,他們都很幫助和溫馨。這裡有三位模特兒在我的課堂裡。看看這三位模特兒。請用although來介紹他們好,让我们检查一下。虽然Henry不太会说英语,但是他每天都在练习。虽然Lisa是几个世界上的女孩,她和每个同学都很熟悉。虽然Amy认为她的数学问题很难解决,她从来没有承担过其他答案。所以,你认为她们有什么想法?我认为Henry很努力,Lisa很友善,而Amy很诚实。Henry很努力,Lisa很友善,Amy很诚实。Amy很诚实。模特儿在我们身边。现在,我在我的课上展示了三个模特儿。你喜欢选择模特儿在你的课上吗?请用虽然来说一些话。现在让我看看你选择了谁。Ben是我们课上的模特儿。虽然他不强壮,但他很能打球。Kin是我们课上的模特儿。虽然他不够练习,但他经常在课上做一些活动。Tina是我们课上的模特儿。虽然她忙着学习,但她写了很多文章。你选择了Ben、Tim和Tina为模特儿。除了模特儿,还有很多其他模特儿在我们身边。这里有三个模特儿在我们的附近。请在课上展示一张图表。让我们听听录音,让我们有更多的详细。Hello, boys and girls.I am Seven, your new English teacher.I live in Garden Estate.There are so many great neighbors.Let me introduce three of them.Wang lives next to me.Although his kid is very naughty, he never gets angry.When she doesn't do her homework well, he helps her patiently.Ding is my workmate.Although she has a lot of work to do every day, she takes charge of her class carefully and looks after every student well.Ken is a boss.Although he is busy managing his company, he works as a volunteer in our neighborhood at weekends.How lucky I am to have such great neighbors.I really learn a lot from them.OK, have you got the answers?Now let's check.The first one, although Mr.Wang's kid is very naughty and doesn't do her homework well, he never gets angry.Instead, he helps her patiently.The second one, although Ms.Ding has a lot of work to do, she always takes charge of her class carefully.And how about Ken?Although Ken is busy, he works as a volunteer in the neighborhood at weekends.What do you think of them?I think Mr.Wang is kind, Ms.Ding is responsible, and Ken is helpful.Good, I quite agree with you.Wang is kind and patient.Ding is careful and responsible, and Ken is helpful and warm-hearted.So far, we have talked about so many models, including story characters, model students, model neighbors, model teachers, and so on.Do you still remember the question I asked you at the very beginning of the lesson?Why do we learn from them?Yes, in order to be better.Then how can we become better?Yes, by learning from others.Now it's your turn to say something about yourself and your model.What's your name?Who can you learn from?What can you learn from him or her?Why or how can you learn from him or her?What can you do?Here is an example from my student Cindy.I am Cindy.I want to be more popular in my class.I can learn from Jessie.Although she doesn't have much pocket money, she saves it to help people in need.Although she is busy with her studies, she always helps her classmates with math problems.I will try to help more people, just like Jessie.Ok, what do you think of Cindy's work?Let's take a look.Has Cindy mentioned who she can learn from?Yes, I can learn from Jessie.She made it so she can get a star.And what can Cindy learn from Jessie?This part.Does she use although?Yes, so one more star.Then does the paragraph include this point?Yes, these two sentences tell us yes.So, three stars in all.Well done, Cindy.These three questions can be used as the checklist.Now it's your turn to write a paragraph about yourself and your models.Don't forget to use this checklist as a reference.I have a lot of work to do.I'm going to work on the next chapter.I'm going to get a job.I'm going to be a model.中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供 by 陈憶中文字幕提供
